Cloud Applications Resource Get Cloud Applications Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/cloudApplications/lite

Gets the list of predefined and custom cloud applications

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
pageNumber
int32

Specifies the page number. The numbering starts at 0.

Default value: 0
limit
int32

Specifies the maximum number of cloud applications that must be retrieved in a page

Default value: 1000
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

Unique identifier of the cloud application

name
string

The name of the cloud application

]
